changelog: Sekiro Verified Library Support & Launcher Compatibility v0.1.7
features: Sekiro Steam Library Verification: Added Steam App ID 814380 to default verified compatibility list
Enhanced Custom Game Scanner: Automatically maps manually added Sekiro executables to DX11 and verified compatibility
Universal Machine Compatibility: Allowed UAC elevation services (svchost, consent) and NexVR launcher names
Elevated Dependency Synchronization: Automatically deploys onnxruntime, DirectML, and vrinject.json to protected Program Files directories
fixes: Fixed Sekiro game not displaying as verified in tester library
Fixed icon extraction for Sekiro executable in launcher custom library
Fixed Error 22 (Unauthorized caller) on tester machines with standard Windows UAC
Fixed silent injection failure in Sekiro caused by missing elevated permissions to write to Steam game directories
